Headline CPI slowed to 3.5% year-over-year from 4.2%, below the 3.8% forecast, while prices fell 0.4% on the month versus expectations for a 0.1% decline.

Core inflation also surprised to the downside, easing to 2.6% year-over-year from 2.9%, while the monthly core reading was unchanged (0.0%), its softest pace since January 2021.

Energy prices led the decline as gasoline prices tumbled, but underlying inflation also cooled, with shelter posting its smallest monthly increase since January 2021 and core services ex-shelter recording their weakest reading since May 2020.
